title: On Posing for the painter all morning
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：pose　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pose 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the director ① posed for the painter all morning in public, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② poses for the painter all morning in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ pose for the painter all morning at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ posed for the painter all morning before — a line in the poster for August 1953 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Posing for the painter all morning in public, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ pose a question nobody could answer in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Pose a question nobody could answer at once and never mention it again.

By 1966 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ poses a question nobody could answer in public every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ posed for the painter all morning again when nobody else would.

⑩ To pose for the painter all morning, my mother said in 1971, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody poses for the painter all morning in silence again and somebody must pose for the painter all morning in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 摆姿势（一般过去式 posed for the painter all morning：1959 年导演头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 摆姿势（一般现在 poses for the painter all morning：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 摆姿势（不定式 to pose for the painter all morning：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 摆姿势（过去完成时 had posed for the painter all morning：1953 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 摆姿势（动名词 posing for the painter all morning 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 提出（pose a question nobody could answer：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去提出一个谁也答不上来的问题）
G. v. 提出（pose a question nobody could answer：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 摆姿势（后段两处：新来的演员照例 poses a question nobody could answer，而母亲又一次 posed for the painter all morning）

pose 意为“摆姿势”，自那以后导演一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 poses。

pose 意为“摆姿势”，新来的演员每个夜晚都照例提出一个谁也答不上来的问题，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 poses。
pose 意为“摆姿势”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面摆姿势给画师摆了一上午的姿势，用一般过去式 posed 叙述。
pose 意为“摆姿势”，结尾那句是母亲 1971 年的话：要摆姿势给画师摆了一上午的姿势，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 pose 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the director posed for the painter all morning in public, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director poses for the painter all morning in silence whenever the theatre asks.
Posing for the painter all morning in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever pose a question nobody could answer in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre poses a question nobody could answer in public every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother posed for the painter all morning again, and the theatre remembered that half.
